name: Immersa Core Starter Templates & AI
author: codefreex

sections.description:
Immersa Core helps you build faster with the Immersa Builder theme. It adds a guided setup wizard, starter templates, reusable block patterns, a coming soon block template, Elementor-ready import support, global style presets, and optional AI writing tools.

The plugin is built for site launches, landing pages, business websites, personal brands, agencies, coaches, local services, and WooCommerce-ready projects. Start with a starter template, adjust fonts and colors, import pages, then use block patterns or AI content tools to finish the site.

Key Features

  • Starter templates for complete website layouts.
  • Elementor-ready import support when a starter package includes Elementor template data.
  • Reusable block patterns for heroes, feature sections, landing pages, and coming soon pages.
  • Guided setup wizard for business type, starter template, fonts, colors, and layout.
  • Local starter template imports for agencies, coaches, and local businesses.
  • Global style presets for typography, color palettes, and layouts.
  • Optional AI tools for blog drafts, title ideas, slugs, excerpts, CTAs, FAQs, and page copy.
  • Manual recommended-plugin links for tools such as Elementor, WooCommerce, SEO, forms, and analytics.

Starter Templates

Immersa Core includes bundled starter templates that can be imported without connecting to a remote service. These starter templates are designed for the Immersa Builder theme and include pages, menus, widgets, settings, and style presets.

Remote starter template catalogs can also be enabled from the Themefreex Services settings. Remote services are optional and are off by default.

Elementor Templates

Immersa Core can import Elementor page and library template data when that data is included in a starter package. If Elementor is active, the importer can apply Elementor-friendly page settings and full-width templates so imported layouts are ready to edit.

Elementor is not installed or activated automatically. If you want to use Elementor templates, install Elementor from the WordPress plugin directory yourself.

Block Patterns And Coming Soon Templates

The plugin registers reusable block patterns that work in the WordPress block editor, including a coming soon landing page pattern, a service hero pattern, and a three-column feature grid. These patterns can be inserted from the block editor and customized like normal WordPress blocks.

Optional AI Content Tools

AI tools are included but disabled until an administrator enables Themefreex Services. After connecting, you can generate content ideas, starter drafts, excerpts, FAQs, slugs, CTAs, and short page copy from inside WordPress.

AI generation uses credits managed by Themefreex. No OpenAI API key is required on your WordPress site.

Privacy And Data Sent To Themefreex.com

Immersa Core works locally for bundled starter templates and block patterns. It does not contact Themefreex just because the plugin is activated.

When an administrator enables Themefreex Services, the following data may be sent to https://themefreex.com:

  • Service connection: site URL, site name, admin email, generated site token, WordPress version, and plugin version.
  • AI generation: prompt text, selected generation type, optional context, post ID, tone, word count, site URL, site token, timestamp, plugin version, WordPress version, and HMAC request signature.
  • Credit sync: site URL and site token.
  • Remote starter template import: selected starter template slug, site URL, and license key only when importing Pro starter templates.
  • License validation: license key and site URL, only when Immersa Pro is installed and a Pro feature is requested.
  • Help tutorials: a request to the Themefreex tutorial endpoint after services are enabled.
  • YouTube tutorial thumbnails: if a Themefreex tutorial includes a YouTube video ID, the administrator browser loads the thumbnail from https://img.youtube.com; Google/YouTube may receive the video ID, IP address, user agent, and standard browser request data.

AI prompts are processed by the Themefreex service and may be forwarded to the AI provider configured on Themefreex for generation. Generated content and local generation history are stored on your WordPress site.

Themefreex policies:

  • Privacy Policy: https://themefreex.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms: https://themefreex.com/terms-conditions/

YouTube/Google policies for tutorial thumbnails:

  • YouTube Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Immersa Pro

Immersa Pro is an optional commercial add-on distributed outside WordPress.org. This free plugin can detect whether Immersa Pro is installed and active, but it does not install, activate, update, or download Pro code.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin ZIP from WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Immersa Core from the Plugins screen.
  3. Use the Immersa Core admin menu to open the setup wizard or starter templates.
  4. Optional: open Immersa Core > Core Settings > Themefreex Services to review and enable remote services.
sections.faq:
Is this the Immersa Builder theme?

No. Immersa Builder is the theme. Immersa Core is the companion plugin that adds starter templates, imports, block patterns, coming soon layouts, and optional AI tools.

Does the plugin contact Themefreex on activation?

No. Activation creates local options only. Themefreex Services are disabled until an administrator enables them.

Can I use starter templates without Themefreex Services?

Yes. Bundled starter templates and block patterns work locally. Remote starter template catalogs and remote package downloads require the optional service connection.

Does the plugin install Elementor or other plugins automatically?

No. Recommended plugins are shown as manual links only. Immersa Core does not install or activate plugins automatically.

Can I import Elementor templates?

Yes, when Elementor is installed and the starter package includes Elementor template data. Elementor itself must be installed manually from WordPress.org.

Does the plugin include a coming soon template?

Yes. The plugin registers a coming soon landing page block pattern that can be inserted from the WordPress block editor.

Do the AI tools require Themefreex Services?

Yes. AI generation, credit sync, and AI service registration require the administrator to enable Themefreex Services first.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No. If Themefreex Services are enabled, AI requests are sent to Themefreex and processed by the AI provider configured on the Themefreex service.

Is Immersa Pro installed by this plugin?

No. Immersa Pro must be downloaded and installed manually by customers who have a license.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Aligned the text domain with the WordPress.org slug for translation compatibility.
  • Kept starter-site importer writes constrained to allowlisted WordPress, widget, and Elementor settings.
  • Renamed the bundled WXR parser class to use the Immersa Core prefix.

1.0.3

  • Added the Immersa Core public identity.
  • Added reusable block patterns, including a coming soon landing page pattern.
  • Added optional AI tools behind explicit Themefreex service consent.
  • Kept bundled starter templates available locally by default.
  • Improved Elementor-ready starter package import support.

1.0.2

  • Improved starter template import compatibility and remote package handling.

1.0.1

  • Improved AI content tools for use from a companion plugin.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with setup wizard, starter templates, demo import, global styles, and admin dashboard.
